summary: Wrongful confinement and trafficking of domestic worker; non-compoundable offence under IPC s.370; compounding application rejected; discharge allowed for Ashok Kumar due to lack of specific allegations; two entry points negating confinement; prima facie case established against Ajay Malik; criminal proceedings quashed for Ashok Kumar; High Court's discharge order upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.343, s.370, s.120B
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.482, s.320, s.227, s.164
final_judgment: Appeal by Ajay Malik dismissed; appeal by State of Uttarakhand allowed; criminal proceedings against Ashok Kumar quashed; High Court's discharge order upheld.
